title: Associate a bank account with its owner
intent: An authenticated user can set up a bank account associated with their own profile.

expected_behaviors.description: A successfully created bank account is associated with the requesting authenticated user.

forbidden_behaviors.description: An unauthenticated user cannot create a bank account.

authorization_constraints: A user may manage only bank accounts associated with their own profile.
assumptions: The account setup request identifies the authenticated owner.
unknowns: Required account fields and account-number validation rules are not specified.
